new_program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    base = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if not all(v in row for v in base)]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if not all(v in [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for v in base)]
    all_nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in rows for c in range(w) if c not in cols]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    edge = [grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in range(w) if c not in cols]
    edge += [grid[r][c] for c in cols for r in range(h) if r not in rows]
    line_color = Counter(edge).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(all_nodes) if any(v != line_color for v in row)]
    active_cols = [j for j in range(len(cols)) if any(all_nodes[i][j] != line_color for i in range(len(rows)))]
    r0, r1 = min(active_rows), max(active_rows)
    c0, c1 = min(active_cols), max(active_cols)
    nodes = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in all_nodes[r0:r1+1]]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(nodes)-1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(nodes[0])-1):
            a = nodes[i][j]
            line.append(a if a == nodes[i][j+1] == nodes[i+1][j] == nodes[i+1][j+1] else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(new_program)
exec(new_program,globals())

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    base = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if not all(v in row for v in base)]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if not all(v in [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for v in base)]
    all_nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in rows for c in range(w) if c not in cols]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    edge = [grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in range(w) if c not in cols]
    edge += [grid[r][c] for c in cols for r in range(h) if r not in rows]
    line_color = Counter(edge).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(all_nodes) if any(v != line_color for v in row)]
    active_cols = [j for j in range(len(cols)) if any(all_nodes[i][j] != line_color for i in range(len(rows)))]
    r0, r1 = min(active_rows), max(active_rows)
    c0, c1 = min(active_cols), max(active_cols)
    nodes = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in all_nodes[r0:r1+1]]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(nodes)-1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(nodes[0])-1):
            a = nodes[i][j]
            line.append(a if a == nodes[i][j+1] == nodes[i+1][j] == nodes[i+1][j+1] else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
